description: Deletes every booking, statement, saved commute and claim in the person’s Untap account, in two steps. A call with confirm=false deletes nothing and returns a summary of what would be deleted, with a confirmation_token valid for 5 minutes. A call with confirm=true and that token deletes the data permanently; each token works once. The account itself is kept so Untap can still be used; deleting the account too is done at untap.money/data. Requires sign-in to Untap.

confirm.description: false returns a preview of what would be deleted and a confirmation_token, and deletes nothing. true deletes, and works only with an unexpired confirmation_token from a preview.

confirmation_token.description: The confirmation_token from a preview. Required when confirm is true; each token works once.

name: delete_my_data
title: Delete all my Untap data
